title: Surgical Tech Shirt — Scrub Tech Gift | Surgical Technologist Tee
description:
Clean, professional tee celebrating the calm precision of surgical technologists and scrub techs. Wearable outside the hospital yet unmistakably proud of the role you play on the OR team — a thoughtful gift for graduations, Surgical Technologist Week, new jobs, coworkers, birthdays, or holidays.

Design details (front print):
- Eyebrow: SCRUB TECH MODE
- Main lines: STERILE FIELD
  STEADY MIND
- Footer: FOCUSED FROM START TO FINISH

Product facts (please read):
- Unisex retail fit
- Front print
- Fiber content varies by color
- Printed to order by a print-on-demand production partner
- Consult the listing size chart before ordering

About this listing: Layout and listing copy were assisted by AI and the garment is produced by a trusted print-on-demand production partner. The design pairs a recognizable work responsibility with the calm concentration the role demands — confident, clean typography with a subtle operating-room visual character meant to be profession-proud and giftable.
rationale: Minimal, typography-first treatment in a blue palette to evoke scrub tones without naming institutions. The eyebrow, bold centered lines (STERILE FIELD / STEADY MIND), and understated footer create a balanced, wearable layout that reads confidently off-duty while honoring precision and composure under pressure.
